title: Group Fitness Class Passes: auto-renewal availability and credit rollover by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states whether the pack may auto-renew once exhausted, the discount applied to an auto-renewed pack, whether unused credits may roll over into a renewed pack and the maximum number of credits that may roll over, and the seasonal promotional discount rate that may apply during promotional periods.

## Basis by tier
Whether a tier's pack may auto-renew on exhaustion, and if so at what discount off the tier's price, is fixed per tier. Independently, whether unused credits may carry into a renewed pack, and the ceiling on how many credits may carry over, is fixed per tier. A seasonal promotional discount rate is fixed per tier for use during promotional periods; where a tier's rate is zero, no seasonal promotion applies to that tier.

| Tier | Auto-renew available | Auto-renew discount | Credit rollover allowed | Rollover cap | Seasonal promo discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | No | 0% | No | 0 | 5% |
| 10-Class Pack | No | 0% | No | 0 | 5% |
| 20-Class Pack | Yes | 5% | Yes | 5 credits | 5% |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | Yes | 0% | No | 0 | 0% |
| Specialty Studio Pack | No | 0% | Yes | 3 credits | 0% |
| Founding Class Pass | Yes | 8% | Yes | 5 credits | 0% |

## Points of judgement
- A tier may allow credit rollover without offering auto-renewal (Specialty Studio Pack), and a tier may auto-renew without allowing rollover (Unlimited Monthly Classes) — the two settings are independent per tier.
- Only the 20-Class Pack and Founding Class Pass tiers combine auto-renewal with a nonzero renewal discount and a nonzero rollover cap.
